pylons_en: 2 H-shaped pylons (two vertical legs, one upper crossbeam about two-thirds up), 135.8 m from the foundation

model3d.notes: Spans 149.5 + 300 + 149.5 m and pylon height 135.8 m from the foundations per VEC (the consultant); the 155 m quoted in the press is Bình Khánh's. Measured on Dân Trí 9/2026 photos: ≈67 m above deck and ≈127 m water to tip (the drawn label), so 'foundations' is ≈8 m below water (pile-cap underside). Upper crossbeam ≈43 m above deck (≈63 %), free posts with flat tops above it, no top beam. 56 saddle-anchored stays (VnExpress) = 14 per side per plane, anchored y ≈47–66 m. Deck 58.5 m above water with a ≈2.5 m crest; clears 55 × 242 m (VEC).

pylon_custom.description: H portal: two vertical concrete legs just outside the deck edges on one pile cap; a deep lower crossbeam under the deck and one upper crossbeam at about 63% of the height above deck; above it the legs rise as free-standing posts with flat tops that carry the saddle-anchored stays.
